_comment: Every channel here must genuinely CC-BY-license its uploads on YouTube. research.py re-verifies status.license == 'creativeCommon' per video before use -- being listed here is a hint to search, not a trust shortcut. Add more by finding the channel's About page and confirming their license policy, not by assuming a conference is CC just because it's open source adjacent.

niche._env_suffix_comment: Suffix for the per-channel secrets (YT_REFRESH_TOKEN_<SUFFIX>, BUFFER_CHANNEL_ID_<SUFFIX>). Set separately from id so the niche can stay descriptive while the secrets are named after the channel they post to.
niche.name: CodeAZ Tech Shorts
niche.purpose: Clip CC-BY licensed tech videos from creators who already edit for attention -- B-roll, hooks, cuts -- because the clipper amplifies existing pacing and cannot invent it. Conference talks were tried first and produced unreadable slides in a letterboxed frame. Every clip credits and links the original video, creator and channel.
